qualifiers.comparison_scope: JGB 21, English rendering; research comparison of critical targets, not a historical transition.
qualifiers.counterevidence_posture: The same passage defeats an overreading in which Nietzsche endorses mechanical non-freedom. It does not defeat the qualified inversion asserted here.
qualifiers.evidence_posture: One currently read translated text, cited through the source-reading note; no independent witness count or remote fixity claim.
qualifiers.relation_basis: The reversal concerns ultimate self-determination versus mechanical necessity. The passage explicitly rejects adopting the opposite account. This supports a bounded comparative relation between the two existing reconstructed targets, not identity, influence, causation or acceptance of either account.
qualifiers.statement: In this research reading of JGB 21 through Zimmern's English rendering, mechanically unfree will inverts the criticized account of ultimate self-origination. Both are targets of criticism; this is not Nietzsche's endorsed replacement doctrine or a chronological change of his beliefs.
